poems.text: 但願人長久，千里共嬋娟。
poems.author: 蘇軾
poems.attribution: —— 宋 · 蘇軾《水調歌頭·明月幾時有》

poems.text: 海上生明月，天涯共此時。
poems.author: 張九齡
poems.note: 望月懷人之作，非專詠中秋。
poems.attribution: —— 唐 · 張九齡《望月懷遠》

poems.text: 芳尊美酒，年年歲歲，月滿高樓。
poems.author: 趙鼎
poems.attribution: —— 宋 · 趙鼎《人月圓·中秋》

poems.text: 唯願當歌對酒時，月光長照金樽裏。
poems.author: 李白
poems.note: 詠月詩；採用「唯願」「裏」版本，非專詠中秋。
poems.attribution: —— 唐 · 李白《把酒問月》

poems.text: 萬里無雲鏡九州，最團圓夜是中秋。
poems.author: 殷文圭
poems.note: 作者生涯跨唐末五代，海報沿用唐代署名。
poems.attribution: —— 唐 · 殷文圭《八月十五夜》

poems.text: 吾心自有光明月，千古團圓永無缺。
poems.author: 王守仁
poems.attribution: —— 明 · 王守仁《中秋》

poems.text: 好時節，願得年年，常見中秋月。
poems.author: 徐有貞
poems.attribution: —— 明 · 徐有貞《中秋月·中秋月》

poems.text: 無雲世界秋三五，共看蟾盤上海涯。
poems.author: 曹松
poems.note: 「上海涯」連讀為月輪升上海天邊際，不指上海市。
poems.attribution: —— 唐 · 曹松《中秋對月》

poems.text: 今夜月明人盡望，不知秋思落誰家。
poems.author: 王建
poems.note: 帶思鄉意味，適合寄遠；純歡慶批次可另選。
poems.attribution: —— 唐 · 王建《十五夜望月寄杜郎中》

poems.text: 明月松間照，清泉石上流。
poems.author: 王維
poems.note: 秋夜山居之作，非專詠中秋；八組意象中以詩卷月光作氣氛搭配，不擅自把桂樹改成松樹。
poems.attribution: —— 唐 · 王維《山居秋暝》

poems.text: 至今不會天中事，應是嫦娥擲與人。
poems.author: 皮日休
poems.work: 天竺寺八月十五日夜桂子
poems.attribution: —— 唐 · 皮日休《天竺寺八月十五日夜桂子》

poems.text: 暮雲收盡溢清寒，銀漢無聲轉玉盤。
poems.author: 蘇軾
poems.attribution: —— 宋 · 蘇軾《陽關曲·中秋月》

poems.text: 天將今夜月，一遍洗寰瀛。
poems.author: 劉禹錫
poems.note: 題名亦作《八月十五日夜玩月》。
poems.attribution: —— 唐 · 劉禹錫《八月十五夜玩月》

poems.text: 皓魄當空寶鏡升，雲間仙籟寂無聲。
poems.author: 李朴
poems.note: 採「寶鏡」版本；另有「曉鏡」異文，不拼接版本。
poems.attribution: —— 宋 · 李朴《中秋》

poems.text: 此夜若無月，一年虛過秋。
poems.author: 司空圖
poems.attribution: —— 唐 · 司空圖《中秋》

poems.text: 一輪秋影轉金波，飛鏡又重磨。
poems.author: 辛棄疾
poems.work: 太常引·建康中秋夜為呂叔潛賦
poems.attribution: —— 宋 · 辛棄疾《太常引·建康中秋夜為呂叔潛賦》

poems.text: 小餅如嚼月，中有酥與飴。
poems.author: 蘇軾
poems.note: 以餅喻月，可借作中秋食趣文案；原作非中秋專詩，不據此聲稱它記載了現代月餅。
poems.attribution: —— 宋 · 蘇軾《留別廉守》

poems.text: 人道秋中明月好，欲邀同賞意如何。
poems.author: 白居易
poems.work: 華陽觀中八月十五日夜招友玩月
poems.source_url: https://zh.wikisource.org/zh-hant/華陽觀中八月十五日夜招友玩月
poems.note: 依《全唐詩》卷436採「意如何」，不採二手轉引的「意何如」。
poems.attribution: —— 唐 · 白居易《華陽觀中八月十五日夜招友玩月》

poems.text: 目窮淮海滿如銀，萬道虹光育蚌珍。
poems.author: 米芾
poems.attribution: —— 宋 · 米芾《中秋登樓望月》

poems.text: 湖光秋月兩相和，潭面無風鏡未磨。
poems.author: 劉禹錫
poems.note: 秋夜寫景之作，非專詠中秋。
poems.attribution: —— 唐 · 劉禹錫《望洞庭》

windows.name: 满月圆窗
windows.prompt: one circular moon-window aperture, a nearly round luminous disc with softly feathered edges
windows.note: 圓形輪廓，團圓感最直接。

windows.name: 海棠四瓣窗
windows.prompt: one traditional Chinese haitang quatrefoil window aperture: four broad rounded lobes, softly indented between lobes, wider than tall, not a flower illustration
windows.note: 四瓣飽滿，柔和的花窗輪廓。

windows.name: 梅花五瓣窗
windows.prompt: one five-lobed plum-blossom-shaped window aperture with exactly five softly rounded petals, clearly readable outer outline; no actual plum flowers
windows.note: 以梅花形窗洞為輪廓，不在秋景中額外添梅枝。

windows.name: 六角窗
windows.prompt: one regular hexagonal garden-window aperture with six sides, softened corners and blurred luminous edges, upright and symmetrical
windows.note: 六邊輪廓，較端正；不畫成龜背格柵。

windows.name: 折扇窗
windows.prompt: one broad Chinese folding-fan-shaped window aperture: gently arched upper edge and curved lower edge with two slanting sides, wider than tall, no fan handle and no spokes
windows.note: 扇面形輪廓，以園林扇形空窗作設計參照。

motifs.name: 玉兔・桂枝
motifs.prompt: a small seated jade rabbit in side profile at the lower center, and one diagonal osmanthus branch with delicate clusters of tiny blossoms
motifs.note: 兔小、桂枝疏，保留窗內透光空間。

motifs.name: 嫦娥・桂树
motifs.prompt: one slender Chang'e figure in flowing robes, shown only as a distant soft projected shadow without facial detail, beside a sparse osmanthus tree; a single graceful trailing sleeve
motifs.note: 人物只作遠影，不生成臉部肖像或完整神話場景。

motifs.name: 蟾蜍・月轮
motifs.prompt: one small crouching lunar toad shadow at the lower edge and one faint circular moon halo within the aperture, distinct from the outer window shape
motifs.note: 月宮蟾蜍，無金幣、聚寶盆或招財擺件。

motifs.name: 月饼・茶盏
motifs.prompt: a softly scalloped round mooncake seen slightly from the side beside one small tea cup; their soft projected profiles rest on one low horizontal plane
motifs.note: 可辨糕餅輪廓與杯口；不用食物攝影、商標或雕花特寫。

motifs.name: 灯笼・桂影
motifs.prompt: one hanging traditional rounded paper lantern with a short tassel, crossed by a sparse osmanthus branch shadow; the lantern itself is a projected shadow, not a second glowing light source
motifs.note: 燈籠作投影，桂影疏落，不與中央暖光爭亮。

motifs.name: 桂酒壶・桂花瓣
motifs.prompt: one small traditional ceramic wine ewer with a slim spout and curved handle, with a few scattered osmanthus petals drifting beside it, all rendered as soft cast shadows
motifs.note: 保留壺嘴和提梁辨識度，不畫酒瓶標籤。

motifs.name: 莲瓣瓜・供盘
motifs.prompt: melon slices arranged as a lotus blossom on a low offering plate; a simple lotus-petal silhouette made of fruit wedges, all as diffuse projected shadows
motifs.note: 作「瓜果切瓣、蓮花狀拼盤」的設計解讀，不畫成真蓮花或佛教供像。

motifs.name: 诗卷・月光
motifs.prompt: one partly unrolled poetry scroll with gently curled ends, with one oblique pale moonlight band crossing it; the scroll is a soft projected shadow and carries no readable writing
motifs.note: 卷軸無可讀文字，詩句只在所選版式的文字區排入，避免與窗內主體混在一起。

zodiacs.name: 鼠
zodiacs.prompt: a small rat in side profile, rounded ears, pointed muzzle and a long gently curved thin tail

zodiacs.name: 牛
zodiacs.prompt: a calm sturdy ox in side profile, two curved horns, broad muzzle and four strong legs

zodiacs.name: 虎
zodiacs.prompt: a quiet walking tiger, rounded ears, broad feline head and a long curved tail; faint stripes only
zodiacs.note: 圆耳、宽额、长尾，虎纹淡化

zodiacs.name: 兔
zodiacs.prompt: a seated rabbit in profile, two long upright ears, compact body and short round tail

zodiacs.name: 龙
zodiacs.prompt: a graceful wingless Chinese dragon, long sinuous S-shaped body, antler-like horns, long whiskers and four small clawed limbs; no fire or Western dragon wings; soften all scales into translucent shadow
zodiacs.note: 中国龙：角、须、长身、四肢，无翼

zodiacs.name: 蛇
zodiacs.prompt: one elegant gently coiled snake with a lifted small head and continuous tapering body, no legs, no horns or dragon features
zodiacs.note: 盘曲长身、小头，无角无足

zodiacs.name: 马
zodiacs.prompt: a graceful horse in side profile, long muzzle, flowing mane and tail, four slender legs

zodiacs.name: 羊
zodiacs.prompt: a gentle goat in side profile, two backward-curved horns, small beard and slim hooved legs

zodiacs.name: 猴
zodiacs.prompt: a seated monkey in profile, round ears, small muzzle, bent long arms and curved long tail; no clothing

zodiacs.name: 鸡
zodiacs.prompt: a rooster in side profile, distinct comb, short beak and arched long tail feathers, two legs

zodiacs.name: 狗
zodiacs.prompt: a relaxed dog in side profile, clear canine muzzle, pointed ears and gently curled tail; no wolf or fox features

zodiacs.name: 猪
zodiacs.prompt: a gentle pig in side profile, rounded body, short legs, broad round snout and small curled tail

accents.name: 桂枝
accents.prompt: one sparse osmanthus branch with small leaves and tiny flower clusters

accents.name: 桂树
accents.prompt: a small fragment of osmanthus tree canopy at the upper edge, not a full forest

accents.name: 月轮
accents.prompt: one faint circular moon disc nested inside the aperture, not another window or a second bright light

accents.name: 月饼・茶盏
